name: Cough Drops
composition: It is indicated for mucus buildup in the air passages
dosage:
Ten drops in some water every hour for 2-3 days

Safety Information:

Do not exceed the recommended dosage
Read the label carefully before use
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Keep out of reach of children
